body.prompt: Close-up inside a dark leather Roman command tent on the Danube at night, an iron brazier glowing orange, deep blue shadow by an oil lamp: an old man's hand with a crimson sleeve writing with a reed pen on a wax tablet, only blurred strokes with nothing readable, ink pot and a small stack of papyrus beside it.
